storyboard.claim: The book's whole method comes down to one quiet question, asked calmly even as pressure piles up.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The philosopher speaks in an even, unhurried stance while the young man beside him shrugs and worries under other people's expectations.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the boundary the narration just defined to the quiet tool that holds it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Splits 'calmly in the face of pressure' across two faces — one composed, one visibly buckling; the contrast carries the beat.

storyboard.claim: The question sorts your life: work out which task is actually yours, then handle that one yourself.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The philosopher holds out a compass as he speaks, offering the young man a way to tell his own task from everyone else's.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the quiet question the previous beat announced — it is a sorting question about whose task this is.
storyboard.addedInformation: Turns 'figure out what is yours' into a visible act of choosing a direction; earnestness and community feeling read through his steady posture.

storyboard.claim: Everything that is not yours gets handed back to the person it belongs to — then the question turns on you.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The philosopher reaches out and passes a stack of borrowed notes back to the young man, emptying his own hands before the closing question.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the sorting of tasks (whose task) with the disposal of everything that failed the test.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes 'hand back' literal — a physical return a muted viewer reads as giving someone else's load back.

callout.text: if you handed back every task

storyboard.claim: Picture your worst current stress: if you handed back every task judged by someone else, what weight would be left for you?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Night bedroom: the young man sits awake on the edge of the bed, hand pressed to his chest — the question that will not let him sleep.
storyboard.onScreenText: if you handed back every task
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Applies the handing-back from the philosopher's hands to the viewer's own sleepless source of stress.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives 'biggest source of stress' a measurable size (the boulder) and grounds 'keeping you awake at night' in a real dark room.

storyboard.claim: The episode ends with an open invitation: keep exploring these ideas for yourself.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Closing two-shot: the philosopher and the young man face the viewer, the argument settled into a shared sign-off.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Hands the lingering question of the last beat over to the audience as a farewell.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the picture only warms the goodbye; the line itself carries the whole message.
